## WF-02: Alarm Normalizer

Standalone, reusable sub-workflow. Called by WF-01 (Alarm Ingestion) via an 'Execute Workflow' node, passing the raw vendor alarm JSON.

Flow:
Execute Workflow Trigger -> Detect Vendor & Validate -> [Is Valid?] -> Normalize Fields -> Ensure Correlation ID -> Return Standardized JSON

Invalid alarms are routed to Error Output instead.

No AI classification, no notification channels, no ticketing - normalization only.

### Error handling
Alarms with an undetectable vendor or missing required raw fields never reach Normalize Fields. They flow straight to 'Error Output' with status='invalid', the reason(s), and the original raw payload preserved - nothing is dropped silently.

'3. Normalize Fields' has retry enabled (2 attempts) for transient failures.
